story.body: In the 1960s, Cruz Azul turned promotion into a string of major titles. The league triumph in 1968–69 was followed by a domestic cup and the club’s first Concacaf trophy.

lessons.subtitle: Titles and a famous final made Cruz Azul the era’s defining team.

story.title: A dominant stretch
story.body: Cruz Azul added three consecutive league championships in 1971–72, 1972–73 and 1973–74. Its 1971–72 final against América became one of the club’s signature wins.

story.title: A signature final win
story.body: A 4–1 win against América at the Azteca anchored the run. Cruz Azul kept the championship through 1973–74, completing three consecutive league titles.

lessons.title: The ninth star returns
lessons.subtitle: A record-breaking regular season led to Cruz Azul’s 2021 championship.

story.title: Twelve straight wins
story.body: Cruz Azul matched a professional-era Liga MX record with 12 consecutive regular-season victories in Guard1anes 2021. The club then beat Santos 1–0 away in the first leg of the final.

story.title: The goal that brought the ninth star
story.body: On 30 May, Jonathan Rodríguez scored after Yoshimar Yotún’s pass in the return leg. That goal restored Cruz Azul’s 2–1 aggregate lead and secured its ninth league championship.

facts.evidence: The official chronology dates the second leg to May 30.

facts.evidence: The club account credits Rodríguez after Yotún’s pass.
